text_block_list.text:
There's a half marathon being held
nearby, so I
drop by to see if I can pick
up any useful tips.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: As I'm watching the race...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's this?! Ines Fujin leaps ahead of
the pack
straight from the start!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Move, move, move!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: I'm going to run... with all I've got!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Strategy for the race? Well...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
If I were running, I'd settle in a good
position
toward the front, then see how
things play out.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I think it's best to go right to the front.
Then you
can keep growing and growing
your lead!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
But if you rush off from the beginning,
you may
run out of steam in the latter
half.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Do you have a backup plan for that,
Ines?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Absolutely, absolutely!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: My backup plan is... believing in myself!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'll exhaust myself! I just
need to
go full speed for the whole race
and win!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I want to capture that moment of
triumph and run
a race my family can be
proud of!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Now's my chaaaaance!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Closing in on the finish line, Ines
Fujin
manages to find yet another gear!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
The gap just gets wider and wider!
Incredible!
Simply incredible!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: I... did it!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: I'm... almost... there!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ines Fujin seems to be out of
stamina!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Noooo!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
She's been passed by the second-place
runner! It
looks like Ines Fujin can't keep
up!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Looks like we've got a comeback
victory, folks!
Too bad for Ines Fujin,
missing it by just a hair!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
The winner is Ines Fujin! She led the
whole way
with astounding speed!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
What did I say? You can't just run on
guts alone!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
That's fine! Win or lose, I have no
regrets!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
(I'm not cut out for complex stuff, so all I
can do
is push forward with all my
might.)
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text: On and on and on again. If I do that...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I might just be able to leave behind my
own kind
of sparkle.
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Going in with a bang and dashing till the
very
end—that's the kind of race I want
to run!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to say you're way out of hand,
but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: INES! INES!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Based on those cheers, I think you may
be right.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
In the long history of the Twinkle Series,
I think
it's finally time for someone like
you to shine.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
